page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: small page-number-like mark "161" (ornament, as printed) above the title block; title block centred in lines; no columns, no margin notes.

main_text.l: DIVI CAROLI V. CONSILIARIO, & Senatore RP. Norenbergensi.
EDITVS NVRENBERGAE AB ALBERTO DVRERO, Apelle Germanico.

page.notes: The "161" at the top is a printed page number. The final line "L MAXI." is the date as printed (MDXI with the M and D, rendered here as printed: the M and the X are not fully clear, read as "MAXI" in the scan with a letter partly obscured before it). Doubtful: the "L" at the start of the date line and the "MAXI." letters are set in a decorative type; the printed date is most likely MDXI (1511). Scan shows some stains and show-through, not transcribed. The printed "ꝰ" and ornaments are not transcribed.
